Title: Toy Box Mystery
Can-do: I can name toys and say where something is.
Student-facing Input: Leo, Mia, Emma, and Toto find a toy box. A toy is missing. They look, point, and listen. Where is the toy?
Model Language: toy box / Where is the toy? / It's in the box.
Try It / Output: Point to the toy box and say: toy box.
Repair Hint: Use the picture first. Say one toy word, then one place word.

Title: Meet the Toys
Can-do: I can recognize and say toy words.
Student-facing Input: Look at the toy shelf. Listen and point: ball, car, doll, robot, kite, teddy bear, blocks, train.
Model Language: ball / car / doll / robot / kite / teddy bear / blocks / train
Try It / Output: Point to three toys and say the words.
Repair Hint: Match picture to word again. Say only the toy word first.
Portfolio Link: Choose toy words for the project page

Title: In the Box
Can-do: I can say where a toy is with in.
Student-facing Input: A toy is inside the toy box. Leo points. Use the frame: It's in the box.
Model Language: Where is the teddy bear? It's in the box. / Where is the robot? It's in the box.
Try It / Output: Put a toy card in the box picture and say: It's in the box.
Repair Hint: If the toy is inside, use in.

Title: On the Shelf
Can-do: I can say where a toy is with on.
Student-facing Input: A toy is touching the shelf or table. Use the frame: It's on the shelf.
Model Language: Where is the car? It's on the shelf. / Where is the ball? It's on the table.
Try It / Output: Point to a toy on a shelf or table and say: It's on the shelf.
Repair Hint: If the toy is sitting on top, use on.

Title: Under the Table
Can-do: I can say where a toy is with under.
Student-facing Input: A toy is below the table. Toto looks. Use the frame: It's under the table.
Model Language: Where is the ball? It's under the table. / Where is the car? It's under the table.
Try It / Output: Point under the table and say: It's under the table.
Repair Hint: If the toy is below something, use under.

Title: Where Is the Toy?
Can-do: I can ask and answer Where is the toy?
Student-facing Input: The team asks about toys in the room. Use a short question and answer.
Model Language: A: Where is the robot? B: It's in the box. / A: Where is the car? B: It's on the shelf. / A: Where is the ball? B: It's under the table.
Try It / Output: Ask one friend: Where is the toy? Answer with one location.
Repair Hint: Question: Where is the ___? Answer: It's ___ the ___.

Title: Toto's Toy Hunt
Can-do: I can follow toy clues with in, on, and under.
Student-facing Input: Toto gives clue cards. Find the toy: in the box, on the shelf, or under the table.
Model Language: Clue: under. Where is the ball? It's under the table. / Clue: in. It's in the box.
Try It / Output: Choose one clue card and say the toy location.
Repair Hint: Look at the clue word first: in, on, or under.

Title: Say and Show
Can-do: I can prepare my toy location page.
Student-facing Input: Make a Toy Location Page. Choose three toys and three places. Practice one question and one answer.
Model Language: Where is the ball? It's in the box. / Where is the car? It's on the shelf. / Where is the robot? It's under the table.
Try It / Output: Show your page and say three toy locations.
Repair Hint: Use the same frame for each toy: Where is the ___? It's ___ the ___.

Title: Toto Finds the Robot
Can-do: I can understand a short toy location story.
Student-facing Input: Watch the team find toys. Listen for toy words and places: in, on, under.
Model Language: Where is the robot? It's in the box. / Where is the car? It's on the shelf. / Where is the ball? It's under the table.
Try It / Output: Point to the place you hear.
Repair Hint: Watch again. Listen for in, on, or under.

Title: My Toy Location Page
Can-do: I can show toys and say where they are.
Student-facing Input: Choose three toys. Put each toy in a place: in the box, on the shelf, or under the table. Show your page.
Model Language: Where is the ball? It's in the box. / Where is the robot? It's on the shelf. / Where is the teddy bear? It's under the table.
Try It / Output: Make your Toy Location Page. Say three lines with a clear voice.
Repair Hint: Choose toy + choose place + say the location sentence.
